- You would want Saya to help rotate cards and get CORROSION on enemies before you do big NUKE
- Coposant or Celest to help build Shields (you can use both if you want)
- And have Sanga use her Exalt(full yellow circle) to bomb enemies based on how much shield you built that turn, whith help of the 2 above.

```TLDR: Saya(buffer/debuffer), Celest / Corposant for defence shields, Sanga for Nuke/Dps```

---------------------
Alternatively
---------------------
Use Goliath to be the DPS. (make sure to get his Wheel[Card] Maxed out, its usueable by EVERYONE in the game, not just himself)

- So I would go Saya, for corrison again.
- Corpsant and Celest to help him.
- Have Goliath break stuff

```TLDR: Saya(buffer/debuffer), Celest / Corposant / Sanga for defence shields, Goliath for Nuke/Dps```

-
_*Corrosion - Adds an extra multiplyer of damage to almost all your attacks.  On any enemy that gets it!_

Depends on what you need, if you need DPS, Jenkins(Brust unit on Ultra Turn) is very good and Sanga(Shields+exalt) is also very good.
If you need Supports, Faith(no need to upgrade), Winkle.
Rotaters/Enablers, Cassiah is a nice option.
